items.title: Clinical Operations Lead (EU) – PhD/MD Preferred – Global CRO
items.summary: Alimentiv is a worldwide contract research organization dedicated to gastrointestinal disease therapies. The Clinical Operations Lead (EU) will steer multi‑national studies, ensuring scientific rigor and regulatory compliance. This role offers the chance to collaborate with top investigators across Europe while leveraging talent from Pakistan and India. You will drive project timelines, mentor junior staff, and contribute to breakthrough treatments.
items.meta_description: Join Alimentiv, a leading global CRO, as a Clinical Operations Lead (EU). Ideal for PhD/MD candidates in Pakistan, India or Europe. Advance GI therapies worldwide.
eligibility: PhD, MD, or equivalent advanced degree in life sciences, clinical research, or related field
5+ years of experience managing clinical trials, preferably in gastro‑intestinal therapeutic areas
Strong knowledge of EU regulatory requirements (EMA, ICH) and experience with global study sites
benefits: Competitive salary with performance‑based bonuses and comprehensive health coverage
Flexible remote‑working options, professional development budget, and opportunity to travel across Europe
how_to_apply: Visit the Alimentiv careers portal and locate the “Clinical Operations Lead (EU)” posting
Upload your updated CV, a cover letter highlighting GI trial experience, and copies of relevant certifications
Submit the application and await a confirmation email with next‑step interview details

faqs.q: Can candidates from Pakistan or India apply for this EU‑based role?
faqs.a: Yes. Alimentiv welcomes qualified applicants from Pakistan, India, and other regions; remote work and relocation assistance are available based on project needs.
Fluent English is mandatory; additional proficiency in a European language (e.g., German, French) is advantageous but not required.
Travel is expected for site visits and sponsor meetings, typically 20‑30% of the time, with all expenses covered by the company.

faqs.q: What are the key performance metrics for this position?
faqs.a: Metrics include on‑time study start-up, adherence to budget, regulatory submission success rate, and team mentorship outcomes.

items.summary: Andromeda Delta is hiring experienced Audio Transcription QA specialists to review Turkish speech recordings. You will resolve word‑level transcription and timestamp discrepancies, ensuring high‑quality data for AI training. This remote position welcomes talent from Pakistan, India, Europe and beyond. Work flexible hours, collaborate with a global team, and advance your career in language technology.

Strong command of Turkish (native or near‑native) and excellent English reading skills
Familiarity with transcription tools, timestamp annotation, and quality‑control guidelines
benefits: Competitive hourly rate with performance bonuses
Fully remote work – set your own schedule within agreed time zones
